sourceChecks.text: Now these are those who came to David to Ziklag while he was a fugitive from Saul the son of Kish. They were among the mighty men, his helpers in war.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 1CH 12:1 introduces those who came to David at Ziklag.

sourceChecks.text: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite;
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 1CH 12:3 identifies Jeziel and Pelet as sons of Azmaveth.
